decisions.reason: Aligned with the firm's established secure communication offering and showing no clear performance shortfall, it is retained using organizational slack.
As a multi-layer end-to-end security architecture that received its own webpage, it likely meets aspirations and supports the strategic direction toward broader secure ecosystems.
The QR-code-based hardware signature token is close to the established offer but faces some market uncertainty for hardware tokens, so it is kept with a moderately higher drop risk.
The payment network security compliance suite addresses demanding regulatory requirements and aligns with the firm's compliance value proposition, so it is retained.
